name: @clinicrecall/web
description: ClinicRecall web app — Next.js App Router frontend.
//: JSON has no comment syntax, so the notes on this dependency list live here.
@supabase/ssr + supabase-js: auth only, and only ever with the public anon key.
The service-role key must never be imported anywhere under apps/web (SPEC 3.2);
scripts/check-bundle-secrets.sh fails the build if it is.
cva / clsx / tailwind-merge / lucide-react: the primitives shadcn/ui is built on.
shadcn/ui components are copy-pasted source under src/components/ui, not a package.
tailwindcss v4: configured from CSS (see src/app/globals.css), so there is no
tailwind.config.js in this project. That is expected, not missing.
capture the README screenshots, and run the accessibility pass (SPEC 10, 11).
